LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News>
[After CES2006①]AVING Produced the Largest News Coverage about CES 2006

As the CES 2006 was reaching to the end, it has been found that AVING has produced the largest amount of news coverage about CES 2006 through more than 70 online news channel and major portals. In fact, collectively 8 AVING reporters flied to Las Vegas and spent the busy days exploring hundreds of booths in the exhibition area.
(Picture 2: the main page of CES official website. It delivered the service in 7 languages)

The primary goal of this special news coverage was to deliver the news about the exhibitors as many as possible to the global market, so AVING special reports team didn''t even have time to sleep at night. As a result, AVING reporters, starting from January 2, began to deliver vivid visual news about CES 2006 in the field and have produced more than 300 visual news about the show so far through its global news network.
(Picture 3: the entrance of the Press Room at CES 2006. When you walk into the press room ''Welcome'' sign in 6 languages greets you)
(Picture 4, 5: Hundreds of reporters packed the press room)
AVING will continue to report news about the CES and the exhibitors as the show evolves each year, trying to record a history of products.
(Picture 6,7: Approximately 130,000 people visited CES 2006 including press members, analysts, and industry affiliates)
< AVING Special Report Team for 2006 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Yoojin Kim / IKKim, Alliah Seo correspondents of AVING to CES / edited by Daniel Sirh >
